**Short answer:**  
If the repo were accidentally exposed, the blast radius would be *very large* – essentially the entire invoicing service and all of its downstream systems (database, Stripe, AWS, Twilio, SendGrid, etc.) would be compromised.  

---

### Why it’s so big

| What’s in the repo | What it gives an attacker | Immediate impact |
|--------------------|---------------------------|------------------|
| **`.env` (committed)** | All secrets are in plain text | Full read/write access to every service |
